notes.title: Dismantled 2 Demo Update
notes.notes:
Happy happy time, enjoy, have fun etc! A little something for all you people waiting for the full release.
I got you a nice update with more content, here's the changelog for more infos:

Dismantled 2: Flaying Symphony v2.0

Bug Fixes:
-Enemies Could move towards your position while in examine window.
-Default options settings were all bugged out.
-Mouse sensitivity was not saving properly.
-Many sounds were still heard while playing with sounds off.

Changes:
-Weapons can now be reloaded on the go.
-Bigger items colision boxes, makes the items easier to grab.
-Brand new Arena Mode, 1 Arena available to play in the demo!
-1 Unlockable Secret for the demo.

notes.title: SIDE PROJECT
notes.notes:
Hey people! This is an announcement day. Got good and not so good news to tell, depends on how you see it i guess. 

First of all, new project in dev started Fabruary 11th  "House of 1000 Traps"  which should see full release very soon!! pages are up on steam and itch.io right now.  I'd appreciate a wishlist if you can and if you are interrested, thank you so much in advance! 

The not so good news is, I need way more time for Dismantled 2. If i can be blunt the game still need a lot even after all this time. Since it was done completely from scratch it took a lot more time. Dev is going great on it, but i just need more time to finish this project. 

I also begin to be tired of working only on this single project since over 3 years now that's why i started a quick side project and honestly it helped me so much to get more motivations. It felt refreshing to start something new, been a long while since i had done something new and completely apart from Dismantled to be honest.

I want, and i need to keep doing side projects for now on while also working on Dismantled 2. it will also help financially because i'd need more budget to finish the project.

I hope you understand my decisions, i honestly think it's for the best that way.
Thank you so much for your support, it means a lot to me.

On that note stay tuned for future projects announcement later this year!


BigProjectAlone


Link to store page for House of 1000 Traps: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2855750/House_of_1000_Traps/

notes.title: Flaying Symphony Update
notes.notes:
Hey people, just a small update fixing problems i've heard about. Couple annoying issues i missed, also made a couple changes to guns. Hope you have fun with the demo! 

Everything is listed here:

Dismantled 2: Flaying Symphony v1.1

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Weapons could be broken by switching weapons using keyboard numerals + inventory system. They would stop working all together sometimes.
- Newborns were badly censored... it would be at random.
- ''You Died'' Newborns animation was broken, the newborn wasn't appearing in the animation.
- ''You Died'' Crocman animation was broken.
- Putting an equipped weapon in storage box would prevent player from switching weapons afterward.
-Credits were unreadable on lower resolutions at the end of the demo.
-Enemies could hit you through bunker's safe room wall.

[b]Changes:[/b]
- One of the bunker track was a bit too loud.
- Too much smoke in the car cutscene, it would hide the whole screen.
-Guns positions on screen have been tweaked so they take a bit less space on screen. (pistol and shotgun especially)

notes.title: Flaying Symphony Available Now!
notes.notes:
[b]Flaying Symphony[/b] (a full length scenario taking place before the events of Dismantled 2) available right now!

After escaping the detonation of the old asylum, you found refuge in this abandoned bunker dating from World War II. But the structure is inhabited by monstrosities that nature could never have imagined. You venture further and deeper into the bunker but it seems that this gigantic structure has no exit. Will this place become your tomb? 

Lost in total darkness with only a near-depleted lantern as your companion. Your courage in hand, you look for an escape to freedom.

Return to the nightmarish depths in [b]Flaying Symphony[/b] to uncover the true fate of June at the end of [b]Bittersweet Misery[/b].


[b][i]Known issues:[/i][/b]
-Spamming keys when starting a game can results in freezing the game into a blackscreen.
-Suomi translation have not been corrected yet.
-Inventory ''USE,EXAMINE,BACK'' window can sometimes appear under another inventory icon.
-Rebinding the Open Inventory key via the in-game options menu won't work. You can rebind it using the main menu options instead.
-You can pause during death animations sometimes, this is not intended.
-Enemies are missing their fire death animations, will be added to full release.
-Guns are missing a reload button, this will also be added to full release.


Happy Halloween

notes.title: Progress?
notes.notes:
Hey people, i'm so gratefull that so many of you wishlisted Dismantled 2... it means so much to me to see that so many people are interested in my story. 

I just want to let everyone know that the development is going really good so far. Despite the fact that i'm now alone to finish the project but i'm pretty used to work alone so... no big deal here. Sole issue though is personal life went really complicated recently, my mental health is really taking a toll and for that reason the progress will go slowly for a while and i will not be able to release the game this year like intended.

I tried my best to avoid delaying the release but i have to be honest it's just impossible to finish this right now. So yeah, most likely 2024 will be the year but i can't tell when either. All i can say is that the progress are really good so far, i also plan to update the demo with a brand new version somewhere this year. It will at least give everyone a better idea of how the full release will be like. Since pretty much all the mechanics from the demo has been reworked right now. 

I hope you will understand the delay, i don't want to rush anything just to meet the release date. Sorry about that but i can ensure the wait will be worth it, i'm putting all my soul in this project.

To everyone supporting Dismantled, thank you so much.
